senses.en_definition: A second; one sixtieth of a minute.

collocations.en: one second; per second, depending on context

senses.en_definition: A moment; a very short time or a particular point in time.

messages.en: Where's the link to that file? I need to send it to the lecturer now.
Just give it a few more seconds—it's at 98% now. I'll send you the link as soon as it's done.
Okay, I'll wait. Make sure I can open the file too, yeah?
Hang on a bit, okay? I'm almost there.
Okay, I'll wait out front of the shop.
I'm meeting up with an old friend this evening.
That'll be nice! You two haven't seen each other in ages, right?

senses.en_definition: Continuously or repeatedly; all the time.
Likewise; equally; to the same extent.
Any; whatever, whoever, wherever or whenever, without restriction.
Easily; with little or no effort.
Just; used to suggest or encourage an action.
Very; used to emphasize the degree of the preceding word.
Indeed; truly; as is actually the case (archaic or literary).

collocations.en: just as the sovereign has decreed (archaic)

senses.en_definition: Intentionally; of one's own will; used to declare an intention in religious formulas.

collocations.en: I intend to perform the prayer

senses.en_definition: As it is; without additions, embellishment or extra assistance.

collocations.en: just as it is, without decoration

messages.en: I'm at the curry puff stall. How many do you want?
Just one. I've already eaten. Thanks for getting it for me!
